photos.view: Front left three-quarter view of the front end, showing the bumper, headlamp, fender and wheel

vehicle_check.seen: Silver midsize sedan (Toyota badge on wheel, Camry-like)

findings.reason: Bumper cover is torn and broken away on the left corner, with the lower section detached and lying on the ground, exposing the bumper support.
The lamp lens looks intact, but it appears to have lost its lower mounting support and may be loose or misaligned.
The front edge of the fender near the headlamp looks disturbed and the fender liner is displaced, but the outer panel is mostly intact.

structural_reason: The bumper cover has been torn off and the radiator support, the area behind the bumper and the front suspension area are exposed and appear deformed, which points to a heavy impact.
